full_text:
Article 4 (Suspension of Payment of Allowances)
Where a member, president or vice president loses such status due to death, disqualification, expiration of the term of office or any other reason, payment of the fixed allowance or position allowance shall cease beginning with the month following the month in which that status was lost. <Amended on January 29, 1996.>
